title: Oriental cheap block and trade inventory
description: Oriental cheap block and trade inventory. The bid is cheap enough to block light-blue completion and create trade value. The hard part is resisting drop_out when monopoly potential and cash survival point in opposite directions.

final_action.private_thought: I have cash 690 and already own Vermont Avenue (light blue). Acquiring Oriental gives me two of the three light blue properties, increasing rent and trade leverage. The auction price is low relative to property cost ($100). I bid the minimum increment to stay in and see if others drop out.
